name: digit_copy
description: Exact copying of a random six-digit identifier; matched controls copy same-length lowercase word strings in the same format.
generator_code:
import random,json,string
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 s=''.join(random.choice(string.digits) for _ in range(6))
 t=''.join(random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase) for _ in range(6))
 template='Copy the text exactly.\nText: {}\nCopy:'
 items.append({'prompt':template.format(s),'answer':' '+s})
 control.append({'prompt':template.format(t),'answer':' '+t})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
